nodes.description: Internal token transfer override implementing blacklist, limits, anti-bot delay, early sell tax, fee taking, swap and LP burn triggers.
Private function that swaps accumulated contract tokens to ETH and distributes to dev, liquidity and marketing.

edges.reason: _transfer reads the _blacklist mapping to block blacklisted senders/recipients.
limitsInEffect gates the max transaction/wallet and delay checks inside _transfer.
tradingActive determines whether non-excluded transfers are allowed.
transferDelayEnabled gates the one-purchase-per-block restriction.
tx.origin is used as key for the per-block transfer delay, making the restriction origin-dependent.
block.timestamp drives the early sell tax window inside _transfer.
maxTransactionAmount is enforced on buys and sells.
maxWallet caps recipient balances on buys and wallet transfers.
automatedMarketMakerPairs classifies transfers as buys, sells or wallet moves.
_isExcludedFromFees disables fee taking and gates the swap and LP burn triggers.
swapTokensAtAmount is the threshold deciding whether swapBack is invoked.
swapEnabled must be true for the automatic swap to run.
swapping acts as a reentrancy guard read before calling swapBack.
lpBurnEnabled gates the automatic LP burn call.
lastLpBurnTime plus lpBurnFrequency controls when the auto burn triggers.
buyTotalFees is used to compute buy fees.
sellTotalFees is used to compute sell fees.
tokensForMarketing is accumulated during fee taking.
tokensForLiquidity is accumulated during fee taking.
tokensForDev is accumulated during fee taking.
launchedAt is used by the anti-bot blacklisting logic.
_balances is read through balanceOf for max wallet and contract balance checks.
uniswapV2Pair identifies buy transfers and is excluded from the anti-bot blacklist.
_holderFirstBuyTimestamp determines early sell tax application.
_holderLastTransferTimestamp enforces the per-block purchase delay.
enableEarlySellTax toggles the early sell tax branch.
_transfer calls swapBack when swap conditions are satisfied.
_transfer calls autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens on sell transactions past the burn interval.
_transfer writes accumulated marketing token accounting.
_transfer writes accumulated liquidity token accounting.
_transfer writes accumulated dev token accounting.
_transfer sets the swapping reentrancy guard around swapBack.
_transfer updates the per-origin last transfer block.
_transfer records first buy timestamps.
_transfer blacklists early buyers during the anti-bot window.
_transfer mutates balances through super._transfer.
_transfer mutates sellTotalFees for early sells.
_transfer reads and applies buyTotalFees to compute fees.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens into ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity with the reserved token and ETH amounts.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call to devWallet which can execute arbitrary code before marketing payment and state finalization.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call to marketingWallet forwarding the entire remaining balance.
devWallet state variable is the destination of the low-level ETH call.
marketingWallet state variable is the destination of the low-level ETH call.
swapBack resets tokensForLiquidity after distribution.
swapBack resets tokensForMarketing after distribution.
swapBack resets tokensForDev after distribution.
swapBack reads the contract token balance via balanceOf.
swapTokensForEth calls the external Uniswap router swap function.
swapTokensForEth uses uniswapV2Router address and WETH for the swap path.
addLiquidity calls the external router addLiquidityETH with ETH value.
addLiquidity sends the router address as the spender and liquidity target.
addLiquidity calls _approve which writes the allowance mapping.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls the external pair.sync() after burning LP tokens.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens updates lastLpBurnTime.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens uses percentForLPBurn for the burn amount.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads the pair address and its token balance.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls the external pair.sync() after burning LP tokens.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens updates lastManualLpBurnTime.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads the pair balance before burning.
onlyOwner restricts manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens to _owner.
The constructor invokes _mint to create the initial supply.
The constructor mints the total supply to msg.sender.
The constructor sets the immutable uniswapV2Router.
The constructor creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair.
The constructor initializes marketingWallet to the owner.
The constructor initializes devWallet to the owner.
The Ownable base constructor sets _owner to the deployer.
Minting increases the recipient balance in _balances.
Minting increases _totalSupply.
enableTrading sets lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp.
The automatic burn interval is measured with block.timestamp.
The manual burn cooldown relies on block.timestamp.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner check on _owner.
enableTrading is restricted to the owner.
setAutoLPBurnSettings is restricted to the owner.
updateMaxTxnAmount is restricted to the owner.
removeLimits is restricted to the owner.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
swapBack transfers the dev share of ETH to devWallet before finalizing the marketing payout.
swapBack transfers the remaining contract ETH balance to marketingWallet at the end.

normalization_plan.reason: from is only used inside _transfer for blacklist, pair classification and balance updates.
to is only used inside _transfer for blacklist, limits, delay and fee classification.
amount is only consumed inside _transfer for limit checks and fee math.
newMarketingWallet is assigned to marketingWallet inside updateMarketingWallet.
newWallet is assigned to devWallet inside updateDevWallet.
account indexes the _blacklist mapping in blacklistAccount.
isBlacklisted is stored into _blacklist in blacklistAccount.
newAmount is validated and written to swapTokensAtAmount.
newNum is validated and scaled into maxTransactionAmount/maxWallet.
_frequencyInSeconds is stored into lpBurnFrequency in setAutoLPBurnSettings.
_percent is stored into percentForLPBurn in setAutoLPBurnSettings.
percent drives the burn amount in manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
_marketingFee is assigned to buyMarketingFee in updateBuyFees.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary read of balanceOf(address(this)) inside _transfer.
fees is the transient fee amount computed and transferred in _transfer.
totalTokensToSwap aggregates the pending token allocations in swapBack.
contractBalance is the capped working balance in swapBack.
liquidityTokens is the transient liquidity reservation in swapBack.
amountToSwapForETH is the transient swap input in swapBack.
ethBalance is the transient ETH received during swapBack.
ethForMarketing is the transient marketing ETH share in swapBack.
ethForDev is the transient dev ETH share in swapBack.
ethForLiquidity is the transient liquidity ETH share in swapBack.
amountToBurn is the transient burn amount computed in the auto/manual LP burn functions.
initialETHBalance is the transient pre-swap ETH snapshot in swapBack.
isBuy is a transient branch selector inside _transfer.
takeFee is a transient fee application flag inside _transfer.
success is the transient return flag of the low-level ETH calls in swapBack.
canSwap is the transient swap threshold comparison result inside _transfer.
liquidityPairBalance is the transient pair balance read for manual LP burning.
